name: code-modernization
author: Anthropic

amendments.append: The red run counts only if it fails at an assertion — a compile, import, setup or timeout failure proves nothing, and the run's output shows the failing assertion.

notes: Plugin ships Python hooks and telemetry — not installed; only its proof discipline is distilled. Its proof discipline (canary break must turn tests red; verdict computed by a script) informs TEST-15 now and the upgrade-proof rule proposed for client mode (v1.4 scan, tier 2).
